description:
Tired of janky MPD clients? Same.

`swmpc` is a fast, elegant MPD client built exclusively for iOS, iPadOS & macOS.
A clean, native interface that feels right at home on your Apple devices.

What you get:

• Fast library browsing: Search artists, albums, and tracks instantly
• Sane queue management: Add, remove, reorder. Drag and drop. No friction.
• Full playlist support: Create, edit, delete, and populate playlists without fighting the UI
• Favorites: Quick access to tracks you actually listen to
• AI-powered smart fill: Generate playlists or queue tracks by genre or mood
• Open source: Inspect it, fork it, contribute. It's your app too.
• Universal purchase: One price. Get it for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Done.
whatsNew:
swmpc now supports iPad, with sidebar navigation and a side-by-side player and queue on wider screens.

New
• Search artists, albums, and songs together across your library.
• More Siri and Shortcuts actions for playlists, favorites, volume, and AI playlist generation.
• View sample rate, bit depth, and channel count in the audio output popover.

Improved
• Clearer VoiceOver labels, playback haptics, and smoother transitions.
• Updated default AI models and simpler provider settings.
• Compatibility with MPD servers using protocol 0.21 and later.

Fixed
• Multi-disc albums now queue in disc order.
• AI playlist generation no longer interrupts playback.
• Album artwork falls back correctly when a song has no embedded cover.

Requires iOS/iPadOS 27 or macOS 27.
